app.name: Renaissance
app.tagline: Your music. Any words. Any language.

ask.hint: A song, a mood, a chore, a request. Try "play something calm for cooking"
ask.hintSearchOnly: A song, an album, an artist or a playlist in your library
ask.noResults: Nothing in your library matches yet
ask.signInFirst: Sign in to search your library

home.empty: Sign in to a server to see your music here
home.emptyBody: Renaissance plays from your own Jellyfin server. Sign in once and your songs, recent plays and mixes appear here.
home.mySongsEmptyBody: Tap the heart on any song and it joins this row.
home.recentEmpty: What you play shows up here
home.mixesEmpty: Mixes built from what you play appear here, each named in words
home.recentlyAddedEmpty: New music on the server appears here
home.mostPlayedEmpty: The songs you come back to appear here

signIn.title: Sign in to your server
signIn.quickConnectBody: Open Jellyfin on a device where you are already signed in, go to your profile, choose Quick Connect and type this code.
signIn.quickConnectWaiting: Waiting for you to approve the code…
signIn.quickConnectUnavailable: This server has Quick Connect turned off. An administrator can enable it in the Jellyfin dashboard.
signIn.perPerson: Each person in the house signs in as their own Jellyfin user, so favourites, playlists and play counts are their own.
signIn.errorAddress: That is not a web address. Type the server's name or IP address, with a port if it has one, like music.example.com or 192.168.1.20:8096.
signIn.errorCredentials: The user name or password is wrong.
signIn.errorUnreachable: Renaissance could not reach that server. Check the address and that the server is on.
signIn.errorServer: The server answered with an error ({{status}}). Try again in a moment.
signIn.httpNotice: This address uses http, not https, so the password and the sign-in token travel over the network unencrypted. Fine at home on your own Wi-Fi; on anything else use https.
signIn.expired: Your sign-in expired or was ended on the server. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.tokenEncrypted: Encrypted in this browser with a key the page cannot export
signIn.tokenPlain: Stored in this browser without encryption (this page is not on https or localhost)
signIn.tokenNone: Not remembered in this browser (storage is blocked); you will sign in again after a reload
signIn.signOutClears: Sign out removes this library, the saved queue and the token from this browser.

player.error: This song could not be played. Skipping to the next one is safe.
player.signedOut: Sign in again to keep playing
player.unlock: Press play to resume where you left off

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyBody: Play a song or an album and it lines up here. Anything you add with "Play next" or "Add to queue" joins it.
queue.addedCountEnd: Added {{count, number}} songs to the queue
queue.saveFailed: The queue could not be saved in this browser. It lasts until this tab closes.

lyrics.source: Jellyfin reads lyrics from an .lrc or .txt file beside the song, or from its LrcLib plugin.
lyrics.failed: The lyrics could not be loaded
lyrics.unsynced: These lyrics have no timings, so they do not follow the song.

status.preAlpha: Pre-alpha, phase 1: web playback is live; mobile screens come in phase 3.

library.title: Library
library.empty: Your library appears here after you sign in
library.syncing: Loading your library: {{done, number}} of {{total, number}} {{kind}}
library.syncingFirst: Loading your library for the first time. This takes a moment and happens once.
library.syncFailed: The library could not be refreshed. What you see is from the last time it was.
library.firstSyncFailed: Your library could not be loaded from the server. It will be tried again.

album.notFound: This album is not on the server any more
album.label: Label

artist.notFound: This artist is not on the server any more

playlist.title: Playlists
playlist.name: Playlist name
playlist.emptyBody: Make one from any song's menu, or with the button above.
playlist.noTracksBody: Add songs from their menu: "Add to playlist".
playlist.reorderFailed: The server put {{title}} somewhere else. The list shows the server's order; try the move again.
playlist.notFound: This playlist is not on the server any more

favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on a song, album or artist and it appears here, on every device signed in as you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modeHelp: Simple keeps the big type and three rows on Home. Advanced adds Search, grid and list views, sorting and filters, and details on the now-playing screen.
settings.qualityHelp: Files the browser can play arrive untouched; anything else, or anything above the cap, is converted by Jellyfin on the fly.
settings.albumAwareShuffleHelp: Albums are dealt in random order but each one plays through in track order.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Type above to search songs, albums, artists and playlists

requests.emptyBody: Ask for a song or an album and it shows up here with its progress.
requests.later: Requests arrive in phase 2 with the hub.

notFound.title: There is no page at this address
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page moved. Home has everything.

error.title: Something went wrong on this page
error.body: Nothing was changed. Go home and try again.
error.offline: You seem to be offline. Your library still works from the last refresh; playing needs the server.
error.failed: That did not work. Try again.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again when it is back.
